title: Broncos Country highly anticipating the Davis Webb offense

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos Country highly anticipating the Davis Webb offense
sources.description: It is rare in Broncos Country for fans to highly agree — other than that we hate the Raiders and Chiefs. So when a poll generates a response where 95% agree, it’s noteworthy. Based on our SBNation Reacts poll, this crowd has high expectations for Davis Webb in his new role as Broncos’ offensive coordinator, […]
